title: intentional-divergences
description: The enumerated list of places where the typed schema is DELIBERATELY stricter than the corpus it is checked against. Every entry is a decision someone made and must defend; the suite asserts each one is still live, so a divergence that stops occurring fails as a dead entry rather than quietly widening what the engine accepts.

key_scheme.description: How to read `members`. They are CLASSES, not fixture ids, and reading them as ids silently matches nothing.

kind.description: The argument kind this divergence applies to. `*` means every kind, and a pipe-separated list means several -- both forms occur.

rationale.description: WHY the strictness is wanted. An entry without one is an undocumented behaviour difference, which is exactly what this file exists to prevent.
